paper_title: Narrative Media Framing in Political Discourse
caption: Predicting narrative frames using oracle (human-annotated) and noisy (predicted) labels for their , , , and ; the results are macro-averaged F1.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the macro-averaged F1 scores for three models – Gemini, GPT4o, and Sonnet – under three prompting conditions: “Basic prompt,” “Structured prompt + oracle,” and “Structured prompt + predicted.” The horizontal axis represents the model names, labeled “Gemini,” “GPT4o,” and “Sonnet,” in that order. The vertical axis, labeled “F1,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.7 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Each model has a group of three bars representing the three prompting conditions. The “Basic prompt” bars are blue, the “Structured prompt + oracle” bars are orange, and the “Structured prompt + predicted” bars are green. For Gemini, the “Basic prompt” bar extends to approximately 0.34, the “Structured prompt + oracle” bar extends to approximately 0.65, and the “Structured prompt + predicted” bar extends to approximately 0.38. For GPT4o, the “Basic prompt” bar extends to approximately 0.28, the “Structured prompt + oracle” bar extends to approximately 0.63, and the “Structured prompt + predicted” bar extends to approximately 0.44. For Sonnet, the “Basic prompt” bar extends to approximately 0.33, the “Structured prompt + oracle” bar extends to approximately 0.57, and the “Structured prompt + predicted” bar extends to approximately 0.42. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each model, and no bars are visibly emphasized or annotated.
